name: Keel and ribs
on_complete: The keel is laid. It is the backbone of the ark: everything else will rise on top of it.

name: Hull
on_complete: “The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.” (Genesis 6:15)

name: Seal with pitch
on_complete: Noah covered the ark with pitch within and without, just as God had commanded him. (Genesis 6:14)

name: Decks and rooms
on_complete: “With lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.” There will be room for every animal. (Genesis 6:16)

name: Roof, window and door
on_complete: “A window shalt thou make to the ark... and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof.” (Genesis 6:16)
